title: Under shared/web-shared, import the local query-client re-export relatively, not via @mlflow/mlflow alias
answers: where do I import QueryClient inside shared/web-shared
body:
Convention: code under shared/web-shared/ stays self-contained and does not import back through the @mlflow/mlflow/* alias, so it remains portable.
The pattern: import QueryClient and QueryClientProvider from the local re-export shared/web-shared/query-client/queryClient.ts, and reach sibling helpers such as createMlflowQueryClient with relative paths.
App-level code outside web-shared (app.tsx) still uses the @mlflow/mlflow/src alias for the same factory.
Reviewer-enforced: an alias import added to bootstrap.tsx was rejected in favour of the relative path.
applies: Files under mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/. Does not apply to app-level files under src/ outside web-shared.
says: Make shared web interface components portable without dependencies on the core application.
Decouple shared frontend modules so they can be reused across separate web products.
search: Code under mlflow/server/js/src/shared/web-shared/ must remain self-contained and import the local QueryClient and QueryClientProvider re-exports via relative paths rather than using the @mlflow/mlflow/* alias. Sibling helpers like createMlflowQueryClient must also be reached relatively, whereas app-level code outside web-shared such as app.tsx still uses the @mlflow/mlflow/src alias. This portability rule applies strictly to files under shared/web-shared/ and does not apply to app-level files outside it.
